ActorTalk: A while ago, I joined a forum about journal crafting. I've learned a lot there.

And uh... Someone praised my froggie doodles. Said they're cute and expressive, and suggested I use simple drawings and speech bubbles in my journal. I tried it... and it felt like making my own little picture book.
Are you here looking for inspiration, Lucia?
Not really. It's just... once I start drawing, I want to draw more, and draw better.
If it makes you happy, that's all that matters. I'll be your loyal fan.
Thank you, Commandant. I'll treasure that encouragement.
